P.name: Warpath
P.title: Template:Data Hecarim/Warpath
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Warpath|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Hecarim
|skill        = I
|icon         = Warpath.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to a portion of his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|12 to 24 for 7|1;3 to 18|formula=12%+2% every 3 levels starting from level 3 and capped at level 18}} of his {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* ''Warpath's'' '''bonus''' attack damage will adjust itself to any temporary movement speed {{tip|buffs}} and {{tip|debuffs}} '''Hecarim''' is affected by.
** Since this only affects '''bonus''' values '''Hecarim''' will not dip below his regular attack damage if he is {{tip|slow|slowed}} below his '''base''' movement speed.
* The amount of movement speed scaling to '''bonus''' attack damage is refreshed every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
}}

Q.name: Rampage
Q.title: Template:Data Hecarim/Rampage
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Rampage|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Hecarim
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Rampage.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} cleaves his glaive to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
|blurb2       = Whenever ''Rampage'' hits at least one enemy, he gains a stack, up to a cap.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|Rampage:}} For each stack, ''Rampage's'' damage is increased and the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' cleaves his glaive around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion damage|{{ap|60*0.6 to 180*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = If this damages an enemy, '''Hecarim''' gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rampage'' for 8 seconds,  refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack increases ''Rampage's'' damage by 3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} and reduces its {{sti|cd|'''base''' cooldown}} by {{fd|0.75}} seconds, up to a 9% {{as|(+ 9% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} damage increase and a {{fd|2.25}}-second reduction of the '''base''' cooldown at maximum stacks. Stacks expire one by one every 1 second when the duration ends.
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 375
|cooldown     = {{pp|4-0.75*(x-1)|0 to 3 by 1|type=''Rampage'' stacks|formula=4 - 0.75 * [''Rampage'' stacks], capped at 3 stacks.|label=cooldown}}
|cast time    = none
|cost         = {{ap|28 to 20}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|notes        = 
}}

W.name: Spirit of Dread
W.title: Template:Data Hecarim/Spirit of Dread
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Spirit of Dread|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Hecarim
|skill        = W
|icon         = Spirit of Dread.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies for a short time.
|blurb2       = During this time, he gains '''bonus''' resistances and {{tip|heal|heals}} for a portion of any damage he and his allies deal to nearby enemies, with reduced healing on ally damage.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' surrounds himself with the Spirit of Dread for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 60*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*4}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 = While active, '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|heal|healed}} for 25% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to enemies within the area from all sources, halved to {{ap|25/2}}% for damage dealt by allies. The healing is capped against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Resistances|{{ap|5 to 25}}}}
{{st|Capped Healing|{{ap|120 to 240}}}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 525
|cooldown     = 14
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|cast time = none
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = AoeDoT
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = False
|notes   = 
* The healing cap against minions accounts for every single one regardless of how many are present and/or affected by ''Spirit of Dread'' at the time of cast.
}}

E.name: Devastating Charge
E.title: Template:Data Hecarim/Devastating Charge
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Devastating Charge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Hecarim
|skill        = E
|icon         = Devastating Charge.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Hecarim}} becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and builds up {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} over a short time.
|blurb2       = During this time, '''Hecarim's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} the target, briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them afterward.
|blurb3       = The effects are increased based on the distance he traveled in the duration.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|type=time active|key=%|25 to 65 for 13|0 to 3|formula=3.3% '''total bonus''' movement speed every 0.25 seconds. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}} '''bonus total''' movement speed|ms}}}} for 4 seconds.
|description2 = During this time, '''Hecarim's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a ''Devastating Charge'', empowering it to gain {{pp|type=distance traveled|50 to 250 for 9|0 to 1200}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second. If the target remains nearby during the dash, the {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} ends prematurely and '''Hecarim''' {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} {{pp|type=distance traveled|150 to 350 for 9|0 to 1200}} units, though not through terrain, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and deals them {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 100 for 9|0 to 1200}}.
|description3 = ''Devastating Charge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Hecarim|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description4 = ''Devastating Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Hecarim's''' basic attack timer. '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his {{tip|champion ability|abilities}} during the dash. Devastating Charge's duration is paused during {{ai|Onslaught of Shadows|Hecarim}}.''
|leveling2    = {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 90*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 16}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = spell
|parry        = Special
|grounded     = special
|knockdown    = special
|spellshield  = True
|notes   = 
* '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] while {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
** {{ai|Onslaught of Shadows|Hecarim}} will interrupt the dash.
* If the target does not remain nearby during the dash, ''Devastating Charge's'' effect will not be consumed.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of movement speed boosts.
* The bonus attack range stacks additively with {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* ''Devastating Charge'' will still apply its effects to the target even if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, but not if he goes into {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will apply {{sti|life steal|link=true}} and will affect structures.
* ''"Distance traveled"'' can be simple movement as well as {{tip|dash|dashing}} and {{tip|blink|blinking}}.
* ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will not bypass {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}} but the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} will still be applied.
** ''Devastating Charge'' will still deal damage while {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Hecarim''' loses the {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} from ''Devastating Charge''.
** '''Hecarim''' will not use the empowered attack while {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* The {{tip|dash}} does not follow targets. The target's position at the time of the enhanced attack is the direction '''Hecarim''' will leap to.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
}}
